opening.argument: The model requires registration and a $99 license fee, while also presenting Bitcoin-related pool and package purchases as the route to earnings. The speaker says, “you can start with $ 500 from 1,000 or 2,000 can buy at any time additional pools,” and describes rewards of “8 percent” on the first line, “6” on the second, and “3%” on the third. It further connects team positions, partner repurchases, and daily rewards, stating, “There is a temporary re-investment on every package.” The branching team structure, percentage commissions, reinvestment, and stated $200 cycle value present recruitment and tiered participation as an easy, risk-free path to returns.
